simple.meaning: מַקְהֵלֹת (Maqhêlôth) is a Hebrew word meaning “Makheloth , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַקְהֵלֹת (H4722) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 33:25, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַקְהֵלֹת (H4722) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַקְהֵלֹת (H4722) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַקְהֵלֹת (Maqhêlôth) / H4722 is traced through Numbers 33:25, Numbers 33:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
